clue.text: Distinctions that have to be fought for

definitions.text: Distinctions that have to be fought for

parts.words: Distinctions that have to be fought for
parts.note: regimental honours are won in combat, so the distinctions are literally earned by fighting

explanation.surface: Some awards demand a real struggle to earn.
explanation.definitionFit: These are the names of engagements a regiment may display on its colours after fighting in them.

clue.text: Possibly dreams about one getting honours

indicators.note: about places the rearranged letters around the single letter for one
possibly says the letters of dreams may be arranged some other way

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Someone's dreams may involve receiving a royal honour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Possibly' turns DREAMS into ADMRES, and 'about' wraps that round I.
explanation.definitionFit: To honour someone is to hold them in high regard, the same as admiring them.

parts.note: tea is the everyday British drink

explanation.surface: Asking whether a little drink is in order.
explanation.definitionFit: A tear is a single drop of liquid from the eye.

parts.note: ex is Latin for from, as in ex-works
a tract is a short pamphlet, often religious or political

explanation.surface: Quoting a passage word for word from a pamphlet.
explanation.definitionFit: An extract is a passage taken from a longer text.

clue.text: Doubter is disposed to be intrusive

indicators.note: is disposed means the letters of doubter are set out in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A sceptic is inclined to butt in.
explanation.definitionFit: To obtrude is to push oneself forward where unwanted, i.e. to intrude.

clue.text: Test centre where players try to stay in shape

definitions.text: Test centre where players try to stay in
definitions.meaning: a London cricket ground that hosts Test matches, where batsmen try to stay in
an egg-like outline

explanation.walkthrough: THE OVAL is a London cricket ground; in cricket a batsman tries to stay 'in' rather than be out.
explanation.definitionFit: Oval names an elongated rounded figure, and also the famous Test cricket venue.

clue.text: The only thing a defeated army can beat

definitions.text: The only thing a defeated army can beat

parts.words: The only thing a defeated army can beat
parts.note: the idiom 'beat a hasty withdrawal': a losing army beats nothing except this

explanation.walkthrough: 'Beat' suggests defeating an enemy; here it is the idiom of beating a withdrawal.
explanation.definitionFit: Armies that lose 'beat a' withdrawal, an idiom for falling back.

parts.note: read literally, a police force concerned with driving

explanation.definitionFit: The motoring branch of a constabulary is literally a force dealing with driving.

parts.note: drama students are being readied to perform, and the phrase also means determined

explanation.definitionFit: Being ready and willing to take action is a resolute state; drama students are trained to perform.

parts.note: in heraldry a beast on a coat of arms rearing up on its hind legs

explanation.walkthrough: 'Up in arms' looks like 'angry', but it is a heraldic lion standing up on a coat of arms.
explanation.definitionFit: The heraldic term for a creature shown rearing on its hind legs on a shield.

definitions.meaning: someone who proposes a health, i.e. raises a glass to it
a kitchen appliance that browns bread

explanation.definitionFit: A person proposing a toast to someone's health, and also a bread-browning kitchen appliance.

definitions.meaning: solidly fixed and secure
a company or commercial concern

explanation.definitionFit: The word means solidly fixed, and as a noun a commercial company.

clue.text: Churned up mud at starting line

indicators.note: churned up means the letters of mud at are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: Mud at the start of a race has been churned up.
explanation.definitionFit: A datum line is a baseline from which measurements start.

definitions.meaning: to retain or ... possession
the central tower of a castle, its strongest point

explanation.definitionFit: To retain something, and the fortified inner tower of a castle.

indicators.note: in a down entry going up means the name is read from bottom to top

explanation.surface: A glowing woman heads up to the West.
explanation.definitionFit: Something glowing with light or happiness is radiant.

indicators.note: soundly says the synonym is to be heard rather than spelt

parts.note: to guy someone is to mock them

explanation.definitionFit: A guise is an outward form or semblance.

definitions.meaning: split as two words, within view, close at hand
perception or deep comprehension

explanation.walkthrough: Split as IN SIGHT the answer means close by; whole, it means perception.
explanation.definitionFit: A deep perception of something, and as two words, close enough to see.

clue.text: It provides no latitude for the navigator

definitions.text: It provides no latitude for the navigator

parts.words: It provides no latitude for the navigator
parts.note: the line at zero degrees latitude, so literally 'no latitude'

explanation.walkthrough: 'No latitude' looks like 'no freedom'; it is the line at zero degrees.
explanation.definitionFit: The great circle at zero degrees latitude, halfway between the poles.

definitions.meaning: to complete a course of training, as at a military college
to lose consciousness, as from drink

explanation.definitionFit: To finish a training course, and to lose consciousness, often from drink.

indicators.note: upsets means the letters of various are knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: Several setbacks call for someone to come to the rescue.
explanation.definitionFit: A saviour is one who saves someone from danger.

clue.text: A gardener should get it up before it gets down

definitions.text: A gardener should get it up before it gets down

parts.words: A gardener should get it up before it gets down
parts.note: the weed should be pulled up before it produces its seed down

explanation.walkthrough: 'Gets down' sounds like falling; the weed's seeds are thistledown.
explanation.definitionFit: A prickly weed whose seeds float on fluffy down, so it should be uprooted early.

clue.text: A graduate ordered don to clear off

parts.note: a BSc is a Bachelor of Science degree holder

indicators.note: ordered means the letters of don are put in a fresh order

explanation.surface: A graduate is told by a university tutor to go away.
explanation.definitionFit: To abscond is to leave hurriedly and secretly, to make off.

definitions.meaning: cautions someone
counsels or directs

explanation.definitionFit: The verb covers both counselling caution and giving direction.

clue.text: Look after new hotel for a dramatic character

indicators.note: after puts the word for look at the end
new says the letters of hotel take a fresh form

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look or behold

explanation.surface: Someone minding a newly built hotel turns out to be a theatrical figure.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's Moor of Venice, the title role of his tragedy, is a stage character.

definitions.meaning: a term of endearment, darling
a zero score, as in tennis nil or a cricket duck

explanation.definitionFit: Both 'pet' and 'duck' are British endearments, and duck also means zero, the tennis sense.

clue.text: Riddle — what was the craft of the Jumblies?

definitions.meaning: to riddle is to sift

definitions.text: what was the craft of the Jumblies?
definitions.meaning: in Edward Lear's poem The Jumblies they went to sea in this

explanation.definitionFit: A riddle is a coarse sifting utensil, and Lear's Jumblies sailed in one.

indicators.note: from says the letters come out of Soho in another arrangement

explanation.surface: Being chased out of Soho, a London district.
explanation.walkthrough: Soho is an entertainment district of central London.
explanation.definitionFit: To shoo is to drive off with a gesture or cry.

definitions.meaning: a go in a game, someone's opportunity to play
change direction instead of continuing straight

explanation.definitionFit: A player's go in a game, and changing direction instead of continuing straight.

definitions.meaning: to gaze closely
a member of the nobility, a lord

explanation.definitionFit: To gaze intently, and a member of the House of Lords.

clue.text: One may peg out playing it

definitions.text: One may peg out playing it

parts.words: One may peg out playing it
parts.note: pegging out is finishing the game by hitting the final peg

explanation.walkthrough: 'Peg out' suggests dying; in this lawn game it means hitting the finishing peg.
explanation.definitionFit: A lawn game with hoops and mallets that ends when a ball strikes the peg.

indicators.note: back says the word for ring is read in reverse

parts.note: to ring someone is to call them on the phone

explanation.surface: A woman promising to telephone back.
explanation.definitionFit: A resin varnish used to polish and finish wood.

clue.text: Result of choosing the wrong type for the job?

definitions.text: Result of choosing the wrong type for the job?

parts.words: Result of choosing the wrong type for the job?
parts.note: type here means printing type, so a wrong letter set by a typesetter

explanation.walkthrough: 'Type' reads as 'kind of person'; it is a typesetter's metal letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A typo made in setting type produces a misprint.
